title: focuser_primaluce accepted X_CALIBRATE requests while a calibration step ran, which could leave a calibration run unstoppable by END
description:
The generated handler sets X_CALIBRATE OK when it starts, so the BUSY guard let further requests in during the SESTO SENSO 3 restart wait; queued calibrations ran in sequence, the last cleared the calibration state and END was refused, and the run drove into the mechanical end until the owner unplugged the focuser.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000057.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
